newFindings.fact: CARL legacy digital collection migrated to Primo. The original 1950 X Corps Operation CHROMITE report was retrieved through the current official record. Prior blocked old endpoints were not retried.
newFindings.mapAttachments: Map B/C cited in text but absent from the retrieved report; this is chronology evidence, not polygon coordinates.

newFindings.fact: A date-only 15 September landing frame does not require all of Incheon city to be controlled. Whole-city blue and complete planned BHL on 16 September are not supported by the inspected operational texts.
newFindings.preservedMeasurement: Prior distances and geographic uncertainty remain; no source-history PASS is inferred.

newFindings.fact: 11 open night15/night16 Marine-position fragments traced from Map16. Independent qualitative source-ink comparison found no invented segment. Planned BHL, urban hatching and ambiguous connections were excluded.

UT AMS Inchon 6526III scan was retrieved; its printed edition is 1947, based on 1945 photography and earlier surveys. It is not the AWM catalogued July1950 photo-revised edition. Do not label it an exact 1950 shoreline.
newFindings.datumIdentity: UNRESOLVED; printed +10.4 arcsecond longitude corroborated, not automatic EPSG assignment

newFindings.fact: Inchon_Landing_WFL1 contains three Point layers, no front polyline or control polygon. Princeton1946map metadata has Polyconic and Military grid but no datum/GCP/EPSG. Neither resolves the remaining source gate.

nextGate: Resolve historical shoreline registration/datum and source-qualified control scope. Numeric geometry repair is complete and must not be rerun.
publication: Source originals and geometry remain private; only summaries, hashes and source-independent helpers may be committed.
